Cross-stack concept-review fixes (`2a 4a`, keeping `auto off` so it stops at `ship-review`):
1. Fair-share `Take(count)` grant cap in `run.py`: when granting matches to `play_many`, cap each grant at `min(requested, max(1, math.ceil(len(each.pending) / active_or_planned_processes)))` so a 64-slot engine on a 128-match / 12-core panel feeds all workers (~11-12 matches each) instead of starving 10 of 12 workers, and smoothly shrinks grants at the end of a panel. Replace commit `997e7784`'s doc workaround ("size engine slots to the panel") with the fair-share grant behavior, and add a focused unit test verifying all workers receive matches when `slots=64` on a 128-match panel.
2. Drop the leftover sync special case `1 if inference == "metal"` in `resources.py` (`plan_execution`) so Apple Silicon `async def play` gets the same `math.ceil(loader.max_batch / processes)` coroutine concurrency per process as CUDA; update sizing tests and docs.
3. No additional rental spend needed (Gate 2 numbers are already recorded). Run tests/mypy/ruff and republish to `ship-review`.
